clinical_claim.summary: Two-purpose card: (1) detection of clinical Alzheimer's disease from blood methylation, and (2) discrimination among three neurodegenerative diseases (AD vs FTD vs PSP/CBD) by direction-of-departure on the universal architectural metric. This is the strongest single piece of evidence yet that the IAM-architectural distance is biologically meaningful — generic 'different from healthy' would not produce direction-resolved discrimination across diseases.
clinical_claim.regulatory_status: Not FDA approved. Not a substitute for cognitive assessment, CSF biomarkers, or PET imaging.
clinical_claim.deployment_model: Direct-to-consumer cellular state report. Triage / tauopathy-differential layer. Single blood draw places patient on a three-way continuum.
clinical_claim.report_recipient: The customer; clinician interpretation recommended for the differential interpretation

platforms_supported.operational_note: AddNeuroMed cross-platform CPG-VAL-010 showed per-cell biology replicates on 450K (Eosino d=-0.46 vs AIBL d=-0.43) but universal Mahalanobis attenuates on 450K (drops to near-null vs AIBL d=+0.20) due to 86-95% CpG coverage gap. Per-cell readouts are robust; universal metrics may need platform-specific normalization.

stage_3_age_foreground_subtraction.ad_specific_note: CPG-VAL-011 PASS-AS-NULL at baseline (raw d=-0.004); post-subtraction stem_adult d=-0.19 emerges. The 7-CpG Rule A panel has R-squared=0.26 with age (meaningful age confound) — Stage 3 subtraction is MANDATORY before the AD discrimination score is reported. AIBL excluded from Stage 3 testing (no chronological ages in GEO release).
stage_3_age_foreground_subtraction.ad_age_adjusted_z_output_rule_per_sectio: AD-A-score must be reported as age-adjusted Z, not raw

stage_4_a_scoring.ad_age_orthogonality_note: The 115-cell A-score layer is naturally age-orthogonal (delta-d < 0.05 under age subtraction at the 115-cell layer). This is in contrast to the 7-CpG Rule A panel (R-squared=0.26 with age, meaningful age confound). For AD reporting, the 115-cell layer is the cleaner architectural readout; the 7-CpG Rule A panel is the discriminative readout (must be age-adjusted).

ad_disease_trained_panel.panel_status: OPERATIONAL — legitimate disease-trained AD discriminator. Selected via Rule A criterion (|delta-beta| > 0.015 AND q_FDR < 0.10) on AIBL training split, directions frozen before holdout access.
ad_disease_trained_panel.scoring_method: directional weighted composite (AD-upward weighted positively, AD-downward weighted negatively)
ad_disease_trained_panel.comparison_to_universal_mahalanobis: Universal Mahalanobis AUC 0.62 on same AIBL holdout. The 7-CpG Rule A panel BEATS the universal screen by 0.22 AUC because AD's signal is targeted (immune-class architectural disruption), not broad-architectural. This is OPPOSITE of breast pre-dx where universal Mahalanobis BEATS the disease-trained Xu-538 panel by d=+0.75 — different diseases need different operational scoring routes.

age_confound.required_handling: Stage 3 age-axis subtraction MANDATORY before Rule A score is reported

three_way_specificity_findings_GIFT_GSE5.interpretation: Same Mahalanobis metric, three biologically distinct signatures. Primary 4R-tauopathies (PSP/CBD) show OPPOSITE direction from AD on the universal architectural readout. The methylation patterns in 4R-tauopathies are MORE compressed toward H_min floors, not less — consistent with accelerated cellular quiescence / stress-induced compaction. This is the strongest single piece of evidence that the metric is measuring real architectural geometry.

ad_signature_finding.interpretation: AD immune cells appear ~9 years YOUNGER methylation-wise. NOT a sign of youth — consistent with cell-cycle arrest / senescence in the immune compartment, where stressed cells stop progressing through the normal methylation-aging trajectory.

stage_6_cellular_age.blood_substrate_caveat: Non-blood classes (terminal, stromal, stem_pluri) commonly saturate when scoring blood samples against the multi-tissue 80-cell baseline. Production reports must handle SATURATED status; only OK-status cellular ages should be presented as real ages.

stage_7_tier_breakpoints.operational_note_for_AD: Universal tier thresholds (calibrated against HC permutation on breast pre-dx context, VAL-054b) do NOT discriminate AD because AD's universal signal is modest (Mahalanobis d=+0.20). AIBL immune tier distribution: HC 88% NORMAL vs AD 88% NORMAL. AD operational scoring routes through the 7-CpG Rule A panel (ad_disease_trained_panel above), NOT through the universal tier system. Tier system stays as universal screen — FLOOR_BREACH on any class still triggers downstream workup regardless of card.
stage_7_tier_breakpoints.operational_note_for_PSP_CBD: PSP/CBD signature is BELOW_NORMAL direction on immune class (Mahalanobis d=-0.38). The BELOW_NORMAL tier flag IS the correct operational readout for the PSP/CBD differential.

stage_8_card_matching.matching_logic_summary: Card produces a four-way differential output: AD / FTD / PSP-CBD / NO_MATCH. The discriminator is the SIGN of the Mahalanobis hyper-volume distance combined with the 7-CpG Rule A panel score.

sex.rule: Card runs on both sexes. Sex-specific panels do NOT outperform unified per CPG-VAL-053; unified Rule A panel applies.

platform.rule: EPIC vs 450K matters for universal Mahalanobis (attenuates on 450K). Per-cell biology robust across platforms. Card includes platform tag in output and applies platform-specific Mahalanobis threshold when 450K.

honest_limitations: Not a substitute for cognitive assessment, CSF biomarkers, or PET imaging. Those have decades of clinical validation. This card is a single blood draw with promise as triage and tauopathy differential.
No prospective primary-care validation. All three cohorts are research cohorts with established clinical diagnoses.
Cross-ethnicity validation outstanding. All three cohorts are predominantly European-ancestry.
7-CpG Rule A panel has R-squared=0.26 with age. Stage 3 age subtraction is MANDATORY. Without it the AD-A-score is partially an age proxy.

AddNeuroMed AD detection on 450K platform: per-cell biology replicates (Eosino d=-0.46) but universal Mahalanobis attenuates (d=-0.006 vs AIBL +0.20). Platform attenuation is real for the universal metric on 450K.
AIBL cohort has no chronological ages in GEO release. Age subtraction testing in CPG-VAL-011 used AddNeuroMed + GIFT only.
Stage 8 Path B disease-matrix engine not yet wired. Per-patient reporting flows through Path A (this card).

L9 N7 end-to-end chain-recovery test: full β-matrix run executed 2026-06-05 at Biological_Physics/validation_runs/L9_N7_chain_recovery_2026_06_05/. First run of the full chain (Walther → A-scoring → Mahalanobis) on synthetic patients with known truth. Chain end-to-end wiring VALIDATED. Walther class-fraction recovery VALIDATED at MAE = 0.0076–0.0093 across 8 classes × 3 conditions (well under the 0.10 threshold). Signal recovery confirmed substrate-specific: on-substrate injection (signal placed on cell-type marker CpGs) produces Cohen's d = +10.24 against within-cohort centroid, vs +5.10 for off-substrate injection — 3.5× stronger when signal lands where the chain measures. Two operational findings carry forward: (a) the production Mahalanobis healthy reference is calibrated on real n=601 HC and is not the appropriate oracle for synthetic recovery tests because synthetic patients have systematically different β distributions; (b) within-cohort R3 with unequal arm sizes (n_case=50 < n_hc=200) produces a sampling-variance baseline of Cohen's d ≈ +3 on the true-null condition, so absolute R3 criterion needs matched arms or cross-validation. N7 is a chain-level test run once per chain version; the full outcome document is at validation_runs/L9_N7_chain_recovery_2026_06_05/N7_OUTCOME.md. Per SOP v1.2 §87, N7 is run above the chain — not per VAL.
